english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for hitting an object with a bat or as if with one.

exampleSentences.english: I use a bat to hit the ball.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 zi1 kau4 paang5 daa2 go3 bo1

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for hitting a person or thing with a blow.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 dou2 zek3 bui1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for hitting someone or something with a blow, rather than the specialized senses below.

exampleSentences.english: They strike the punching bag with one punch.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 kyun4 daa2 lok6 go3 saa1 baau1 dou6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically striking something, including repeated blows.

exampleSentences.english: They beat on the door again and again, asking me to open it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢不停咁打道門，叫我開門。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 ting4 gam3 daa2 dou6 mun4 giu3 ngo5 hoi1 mun4

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for striking someone with a fist.

exampleSentences.english: If someone insults me, I punch them.
exampleSentences.jyutping: jau5 jan4 naau6 ngo5 ngo5 zau6 daa2 keoi5
